name: entity-identity-versus-name
expect: one matching name; two distinct verified identities
explain: Separate record storage identity from a weak matching feature. Registration identifiers are synthetic and assumed verified in this example.
steps: Observe that name normalization collapses two labels. || Preserve source records and use distinct verified identifiers to reject the merge.

name: canonical-rule-collision-audit
expect: rule migration collision detected; stable IDs retained
explain: Detect a many-to-one normalization change before applying it. This example audits candidate keys and deliberately leaves entity identities intact.
steps: Compute candidate keys under the new rule version. || Report collisions rather than silently overwrite either entity.

name: unicode-comparison-preservation
expect: equivalent accents compare; distinct non-Latin values survive
explain: Exercise canonical comparison and show information lost by ASCII deletion. Equal comparison strings still do not establish real-world identity.
steps: Compare composed and decomposed accent sequences. || Preserve distinct non-Latin values and assert normalization idempotence.

name: source-url-and-key-budget
expect: tracking removed; identity preserved; suffix fits key budget
explain: Use a restricted URL policy and include the digest suffix in the total length cap. Complex source semantics, credentials, signed URLs and fetch security require separate policies.
steps: Remove one explicitly identified tracking field. || Preserve document identity and check the complete generated-key length.

name: authenticated-record-context
expect: round trip verified; tampering and record substitution rejected
explain: Perform real authenticated encryption and validate two negative paths. Install the declared dependency; the key is random, ephemeral and never printed.
steps: Encrypt and decrypt with the same authorized context. || Reject modified ciphertext and a substituted record context.
limit: Complete local Python example using synthetic data. Install cryptography==50.0.2 in a virtual environment, then run the downloaded file with that environment. No keys or provider credentials are required. This does not demonstrate a deployed key-management service.

name: encryption-key-rotation
expect: old readable; new key active; plaintext preserved during rotation
explain: Execute direct AES-GCM re-encryption with two ephemeral keys. Production rotation needs revision guards, managed key custody and verified retirement coverage.
steps: Read old ciphertext using its declared approved key. || Re-encrypt with a fresh nonce and new key while preserving plaintext.
limit: Complete local Python example using synthetic data. Install cryptography==50.0.2 in a virtual environment, then run the downloaded file with that environment. No keys or provider credentials are required. This does not demonstrate a deployed key-management service.

name: loss-aware-record-migration
expect: missing fact preserved as unknown; confirmation issue recorded
explain: Use an explicit unknown state in a synthetic target schema. Real target schemas must deliberately support that state or route the record to quarantine instead.
steps: Convert known source values. || Preserve missing information explicitly and record the need for confirmation.

name: guarded-migration-replay
expect: migration committed once; replay and stale revision rejected
explain: Execute an actual guarded migration write. The sequential fixture tests predicates, not multi-process database scheduling.
steps: Migrate only the schema and revision originally read. || Replay the stale attempt and confirm no target overwrite occurs.

name: explicit-enum-json-codec
expect: raw enum rejected; explicit codec round trip restored domain type
explain: Demonstrate enum serialization failure and a schema-specific decoding path. The example uses Enum rather than StrEnum so the encoding boundary remains explicit.
steps: Observe that dataclass conversion retains a non-JSON enum value. || Encode its declared wire value and reconstruct the domain enum on decode.

name: version-dispatched-wire-decoder
expect: supported historical payloads decoded; future schema rejected
explain: Translate two declared wire versions to one internal representation. A complete boundary also validates field types and resource limits.
steps: Dispatch each supported version through its known mapping. || Reject an unsupported future format instead of inventing defaults.

name: independent-schema-and-revision
expect: schema stays 2; revision becomes 8; stale edit rejected
explain: Execute a real optimistic revision check while preserving structural version. Source-version tracking is an additional lineage concern.
steps: Apply one edit against the revision read. || Reject a competing stale revision without changing schema meaning.

name: confirmed-fact-provenance
expect: confirmed fact retained; unknown not replaced by an invented default
explain: Demonstrate one explicit promotion rule, not a universal evidence hierarchy. Real applications must define correction, conflicting-source and recency rules.
steps: Mark proposal provenance and review status. || Keep a confirmed fact from being overwritten by an inferred proposal.

name: short-token-rule-abstention
expect: short labels recognized; substrings and unsupported phrases abstain
explain: Show why a tiny exact-vocabulary baseline avoids selected substring false positives. It does not parse arbitrary skill descriptions or resolve natural-language negation.
steps: Compare the naive substring counterexample with exact matching. || Abstain on unsupported phrases rather than invent a category.

name: selective-label-evaluation
expect: accepted accuracy: 1.0; coverage: 2/3; empty acceptance is unmeasured
explain: Calculate two distinct selective-prediction metrics from labeled fixtures. A separate calibration analysis and held-out data are required to validate real confidence scores.
steps: Apply a fixed threshold to the synthetic cases. || Report accuracy and coverage separately, preserving empty-subset uncertainty.

name: frozen-nested-ownership
expect: shallow frozen changed through alias; immutable value stayed stable
explain: Demonstrate nested mutability and a validated copy boundary for string tags. Deep ownership of arbitrary object graphs requires additional design.
steps: Retain a mutable reference inside one frozen record. || Copy and validate the other record so caller mutation does not alter it.

name: validated-domain-ordering
expect: valid ordering consistent; unrelated types and negative ranks rejected
explain: Use a linear synthetic rank with explicit type and range validation. The example does not assert that arbitrary workflow states have a total order.
steps: Validate the rank domain before comparison. || Return NotImplemented for unsupported operands and test rejection behavior.
